# Docker containerization expert

⚠️ The skill declares itself "risk: critical" in its own frontmatter — it executes Docker shell commands (build, run, exec, compose) against your machine. Review before use.
Curated by Skill Harbor — an advanced Docker expert skill covering the full containerization lifecycle: multi-stage Dockerfile optimization (layer caching, build-context efficiency, Alpine vs distroless base selection), container security hardening (non-root users, secrets via Docker secrets not env vars, capability restrictions), production-ready Compose orchestration (health checks, dependency ordering, internal networks, resource limits), image-size reduction, cross-platform buildx builds, BuildKit cache mounts and secrets, plus a code-review checklist and diagnostics for build, security, size and networking issues. By @sickn33, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: standard DevOps knowledge, not offensive security — but it genuinely runs shell commands on your host, so sandbox it if you're cautious; hands off Kubernetes/CI/cloud specifics to other expert skills by design.
